content.description: Hyperlane is an open interoperability framework powering the rollup ecosystem by enabling seamless connectivity between different VMs, chains, and their applications. To date, Hyperlane has facilitated $2.5B in bridging volume and 3M+ messages across EVM, Cosmos, and Solana. Hyperlane is built for many rollups and a one-click RaaS world: anyone can start integrating the entire Hyperlane framework immediately because it is open and permissionless. The CLI lets you plug in your chain metadata and deploy. Hyperlane is highly customizable; for example, you can bridge with a custom gas token or make tokens yield-bearing, and you can enhance security by choosing additional app-specific validators you trust. See our docs to learn more.
